title: HWPE-Stream transaction log
description: Log of the handshaken beats (valid & ready) observed on a hwpe_stream_intf_stream interface by the hwpe_stream_transaction_tracer module. A HWPE-Stream is unidirectional, hence a single log file per traced interface.

schema.description: Schema tag, used to detect that the right kind of log was passed to a tool.

interface.description: Design-time parameters of the traced HWPE-Stream interface.

DATA_WIDTH.description: Width of the stream data payload, in bits.

ELEMENT_WIDTH.description: Number of data bits covered by one strobe bit (8 by default, i.e. a byte).

STRB_WIDTH.description: Width of the strobe, in bits; must be DATA_WIDTH/ELEMENT_WIDTH.

path.description: Hierarchical path of the tracer instance that produced this log.

transactions.description: Beats in the order in which they were handshaken.

hex.description: Unsigned value, hexadecimal. A '0x' prefix, '_' separators and upper case are all accepted; 'x' and 'z' nibbles denote bits that were unknown in the simulator.

seq.description: Index of this beat in the log, from 0.

cycle.description: Clock cycle of the handshake, counted from the release of rst_ni. Metadata for waveform cross-reference only: it is never compared.

strb.description: Stream strobe, STRB_WIDTH bits; bit i qualifies data bits [ELEMENT_WIDTH*(i+1)-1 : ELEMENT_WIDTH*i].
